_about: Verse → Catechism links that are NOT guesses: each entry names a distinctive phrase (evidence) that the paragraph itself contains, quoting or directly echoing the verse. `npm run verify:ccc` fetches each paragraph once (2-second crawl delay, single paragraph pages) and only entries whose evidence is found are marked verified. Paragraph text is never stored. Refs are anchor ids (Vulgate numbering). This is a seed set, not the full Scripture index of the Catechism.
